Elena: Quick sync on tenant burst fallback: should fast-path bypass global breaker for tiny requests (<150 tokens)?
Marco: yes for latency-sensitive endpoints, but gated by a small burst token bucket per-tenant.
Priya: Agree. Proposed params: burst_tokens=30, refill_per_sec=3, max_bursts_window=4. Abuse -> cooldown to per-tenant circuit.
Elena: Fallback priority we discussed: cache hit -> trim context -> quantized variant. Distill only with eval approval.
Marco: Also emit headers: `x-degraded:true`, `x-degrade-reason:CONTEXT_TRIM`, and audit event for every DEGRADE/REJECT.
Priya: Admission API sketch: `admit(request)` -> returns `DECISION=PASS|DEGRADE|REJECT`, `fallback_target`, `reason_code`, `est_cost_delta`. Keep it tiny.
ops-bot: note: rollout plan registered -> canary non-prod -> 5% prod. See /rollouts/tenant-burst-fastpath-2026.
Elena: Tests: small sim with 5000 small-tenants + 20 heavy tenants to ensure fairness. Action: Marco draft admit proto; Priya add abuse cooldown + alerts; Elena update RFC.
Marco: I'll stub the token-bucket in operator and add metrics: tenant.burst.tokens, tenant.degrade.rate.
Priya: Alert idea: if global_degrade_rate>3% for 5m -> page infra. If reserved-tenant degrades -> immediate rollback.
Elena: Cool, sync tomorrow after PRs. :thumbsup:
